pages.title: Take a Seat
pages.text: Cushions are stuffed with wool and come in every wool color. Right-click a seat to sit down.

pages.title: Large Chairs
pages.text: Large chairs stand two blocks tall and come in every wood type, cut from the matching planks on the stonecutter. A darker one with red upholstery is only found in the Scarlet Devil Mansion.

pages.title: Wooden Stools
pages.text: Stools are one block tall and come in every wood type, cut from the matching planks on the stonecutter.
Large chairs can be decorated just like tables: right-click with a carpet or tatami to add a matching seat cloth. Use shears to remove the cloth and get it back.
